title: 'I will build my church'
gist: Jesus' words to Simon after his confession: 'Thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church.' Peter's name means 'rock'; the Church has read in these words Christ's gift of a leading place to Peter and his successors, and the passage is one of the most discussed in Scripture. Only here and in Matthew 18:17 does Jesus use the word 'church'.
original: Greek oikodomeso mou ten ekklesian; ekklesia means 'assembly', used in the Greek Old Testament for Israel gathered before God.

passages.note: The key of the house of David.
The household built on apostles and prophets.
